title: Choose a lexical sense
subtitle: Grammar narrows a word’s possible meaning.
overview: A dictionary gives a range of possible senses, not an automatic verse translation. Form, collocation, immediate context, and genre narrow the choice.
Record the lexical form and a context-fitting sense; resist importing every theological meaning a word can have elsewhere.

sections.title: Choose with evidence
rows: world, ordered realm, people; context decides

items.en: He remains in me; ἐν marks the relational sphere.

items.grc: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν.
items.en: The grace of the Lord be with you; the phrase guides the sense of χάρις.
